## Film Budgets and Worldwide Revenue

This page will look at the relationship between film production budgets and the revenue of worldwide box-office. @fig-budget-revenue displays the relationship between these two variables.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Film production budgets and worldwide box-office revenue"
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])

plt.xlabel("Production Budget (millions USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (millions USD)")
plt.title("Film Budget vs. Revenue")

plt.show()
```
